scope_change_reason: The card's existing-decoder premise is changed. This package uses repeated centre-scatter signatures to structure a paired-plane factorization and separately localizes the centre signal in a changed port basis. The finite raw support-rank sum falls from the predecessor's 126 to 74; after complete-plane source and reader closure, the exact algebraic reader tariff falls from 144 to 81. The complete producer/consumer boundary remains open.

Repeated port syndromes yield a finite decoder whose complete-plane reader tariff is 81, and a separate anchor transform localizes centre signal to eight ports. Neither result is integrated with arbitrary residual consumption, restoration or the supplier bill.
stop_rule: Keep this as a finite decoder result. Do not expand into another construction round until one named consumer contract shows how the 81 complete-plane reader tariff and a third unpaid coordinate or rank-16 delivery survive chronology, restoration, hosting, precision and both supplier caps.
evidence: The selected provider's CANONICAL-WORD is pinned inside the selected replay archive, and the 112x8 scatter is reconstructed from its literal cut instructions. Exact rational replay finds 88 active ports in 24 repeated-signature classes. A composition of 104 integer row-add shears moves the centre contribution to eight anchor rows and zeroes the other 104 rows; a 20-entry integral readout recovers a pure centre signal. The selected port labels are pairwise orthogonal within each repeated-signature class. A fixed-seed screen checks 500 same-class plane pairings; all 500 factor I_9 over F2. The best sampled solution has raw support-rank sum 74 and complete-plane reader tariff 81 (nine rank-9 terms), passes the complete decoder identity and 28,672 exact endpoint cases. The frozen predecessor checks at 126 raw support rank and 144 complete-plane reader tariff. The exact complex-side planning cap for the candidate is 0.005545369479 with two unpaid coordinates and 0.010103325422 with three; the third-coordinate assumption is unproved. No supplier integration or selected kappa change is established.
